This is a partial-information record: other earlier tasks, within-block order and feedback are not fully recorded; their omission does not mean the participant had no prior experience. Do not infer other people's choices, later earnings or research results. Output only the action in the stated format. In this one-shot public-goods game, you and two anonymous other participants each receive the stated euro endowment. Simultaneously choose a whole-euro contribution to a common pool, from0 to your endowment. You keep the rest. Multiply the sum of all three contributions by1.5 and divide it equally among all three. Your payoff is endowment minus your contribution plus one third of that multiplied pool. Other contributions are not known when choosing. Output your contributed euros as one integer.
